name: TeamSpeak 3 Virtual Server
description: A TeamSpeak 3 virtual server hosted inside a TeamSpeak 3 Master service. Create it on a running master; start, stop, slots, name, password and welcome message are managed through the master's ServerQuery.

customPorts.description: Same as the voice port (query key; the query runs through the master's ServerQuery)

editor.label: Server name
editor.description: Shown in the TeamSpeak client. Empty = the service name. Applied at the next start.

editor.label: Server password
editor.description: Password clients need to connect. Empty = none. Applied at the next start.

editor.label: Welcome message
editor.description: Shown to clients when they connect. Applied at the next start.

editor.label: Virtual server id
editor.description: TeamSpeak virtual server id inside the master (set when the service is created).

editor.label: Initial privilege key
editor.description: Server Admin privilege key TeamSpeak issued when the server was created (one use). Create a new one with the Create privilege key action.

script.name: Create virtual server in the master
script.description: servercreate on the master (then serverstop), saves Sid + PrivilegeKey.

script.name: Link the service folder to the virtual server files
script.description: Turns the service folder into a junction to <master>\files\virtualserver_<sid> (after the empty template copy).

script.name: Create the empty template folder
script.description: Creates the empty game files folder the template copy uses (a virtual server has no files of its own).

script.name: Start virtual server
script.description: Starts the virtual server and re-applies the panel settings (slots, name, password, messages, quotas).

script.name: Stop virtual server
script.description: serverstop; already stopped counts as success.

script.name: Virtual server status
script.description: serverlist: online = Started, anything else = Stopped.

script.name: Delete virtual server from the master
script.description: serverstop + serverdelete; a server that no longer exists counts as deleted.

script.name: TeamSpeak virtual server query
script.description: Slots, voice clients and players of this virtual server through the master's ServerQuery. The query name is the virtual server name, so the service is renamed to match it.

script.name: TsServer
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: this virtual server (info, settings, bandwidth, log).

script.name: TsClients
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: the clients of this virtual server.

script.name: TsChannels
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: the channel tree of this virtual server.

script.name: TsBans
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: the ban list of this virtual server.

script.name: TsPrivilegeKeys
script.description: TeamSpeak Browser API: the privilege keys of this virtual server.

script.name: TeamSpeak Browser
script.description: Manage your virtual server: settings, clients, channels, bans, privilege keys and logs.
script.code:
TeamSpeak Browser

${IPAddress}

metadata.notes: TeamSpeak 3 virtual server hosted inside a TeamSpeak 3 Master (hosted services reference implementation, docs/HOSTED_SERVICES.md).
